provenance.execution_label: local CPU committed pilot; cloud not used

arguments.execution_label: local CPU committed pilot; cloud not used

provenance.scope: scalar hidden-memory/OU synthetic mechanism study; not an ERA5 weather-skill experiment
provenance.fairness: same width and optimizer-update budget; GRU arms have extra parameters, reported per arm
provenance.seed_uncertainty: sample std across training seeds on shared independent trajectory splits, not a confidence interval
provenance.crps_estimator: fair ensemble CRPS (unbiased pairwise spread term for iid ensemble members)
provenance.entropy_units: differential entropy of scalar transition displacement in fixed dimensionless x units
provenance.forecast_inputs: observed history only; hidden generator m/eta and future truth never supplied
provenance.potential: known G = -dU/dx with U=0.4*x^2+0.025*x^4; no second potential added
provenance.entropy_regularizer: optional same-mean Gaussian variance KL to train-only reference, beta preset; not raw entropy maximization
